title: Hulotheism
summary: HU'LOTHEISM, noun [Gr. matter, and God.] The doctrine or belief that matter is God, or that there is no God, except matter and the universe.

inlines.v: HU'LOTHEISM, noun [Gr. matter, and God.] The doctrine or belief that matter is God, or that there is no God, except matter and the universe.
